deployment.doc.title: Deployment - Editor - CodeUp
deployment.text: If you want others to access your entire project with a link, you can publish it here. You can choose your own domain. For example, your project can be reached at https://my-project.codeup.space. Simply enter your desired domain in the field below and we will see if it is available. If you want to remove the release, you can simply leave the field empty. After a change, click Save button.
